items.title: English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) – Thematic Review in Scotland
items.summary: This HM Inspectors of Education (HMIE) presentation explores findings from the thematic review of the planning and delivery of English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL) provision in Scotland.The review examines learners' experiences, workforce capacity, promising practice and the challenges affecting access to ESOL learning opportunities.Key findings highlight the need for greater consistency in provision, clearer progression pathways, stronger partnerships and more sustainable funding arrangements.The presentation outlines six recommended actions:- Develop a national ESOL strategy and improve local planning- Strengthen ESOL partnerships- Create clear progression pathways for learners- Increase employer engagement- Implement a comprehensive workforce plan- Review and simplify ESOL fundingThe findings aim to support education providers, community learning and development (CLD) partners, policymakers and other stakeholders in improving ESOL provision across Scotland.Find out more at https://educationinspectorate.gov.scot/

items.title: Literacy and English in Scotland – Challenge questions for reflection
items.summary: This HM Inspectors of Education (HMIE) presentation provides challenge questions to support reflection and professional discussion about literacy and English within Scotland's curriculum.The questions encourage practitioners, school leaders and education professionals to evaluate their approaches to curriculum design, teaching and learning, and supporting learners.Key areas include:- Curriculum design and progression- Teaching quality and interactions- Literacy across the curriculum- Reading for enjoyment- Inclusion and supportThe presentation can be used individually or collaboratively to reflect on current practice, identify strengths and consider opportunities for improvement.Find out more at https://educationinspectorate.gov.scot/

items.title: Additional Support Needs in Scotland – Findings from HM Inspectors
items.summary: This HM Inspectors of Education (HMIE) presentation, delivered by Steven McPherson, Head of Inspection, explores inspection findings on Additional Support Needs (ASN) provision in Scotland's schools.It highlights strengths in inclusive practice, personalised support and positive relationships, alongside challenges faced by schools in meeting the increasingly diverse and complex needs of children and young people.Key areas covered include:- Inclusive practice and personalised learning- Identification, planning and monitoring of additional support needs- Supporting wellbeing, engagement and attainment- Staffing pressures and access to specialist support- Improving learner participation and targeted interventions- Professional learning and inclusive classroom approachesThe presentation also includes reflective questions to support professional discussion and improvement planning.Find out more at https://educationinspectorate.gov.scot/

items.title: Literacy and English in Scotland – What is working well and what could be improved
items.summary: This HM Inspectors of Education (HMIE) presentation highlights what is working well and what could be improved in literacy and English across Scotland's education settings.Drawing on inspection evidence, it explores effective practice and areas for development across early learning and childcare, primary, secondary and special education.Key themes include reading, writing, listening and talking, curriculum progression, inclusive approaches, digital learning and opportunities to develop literacy skills.The presentation supports practitioners, school leaders and education professionals in reflecting on current practice and identifying opportunities for improvement.Find out more about HMIE and our inspection findings at https://educationinspectorate.gov.scot/
